messages.body_plain:
Hi Dietmar,

[2016-07-14 09:48] Dietmar wrote:
> hello,
>
> after update of my Centos 7.1 linux to java 1.8 the plot console inside
> Eclipse does not work anymore.
> I get the following error:
>
> Error in (function (name = "rj.gd", width = 7, height = 7, size.unit = "in",  :
>   Graphics API version mismatch

That means the Graphics API of R. The update of Java probably didn't 
cause the problem, but an update of R.

>
> I tried to reinstall:
>  install.packages(c("rj", "rj.gd"), repos="http://download.walware.de/rj-2.0")

This should usually fix the issue. Make sure that no old versions are 
installed in the R library path (check the path in the R environment 
settings in StatET).

Regards,
Stephan
